verdict.rationale: The Graph `driveItem-list-versions` API page shows that file revisions can be listed via the API. It notes that OneDrive/SharePoint can be configured to retain history, with versions created per edit, per save, manually, or never depending on service and configuration. The evidence does not show a restore endpoint or any concrete retention window. Missing for 10: API evidence for restoring a prior version, documented retention durations/limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of version listing/restore.
